Trigger: Feeding.

Unique to the undead, this derangement instills a persistent fear that any source of vitae is dangerous. Explanations vary: some vampires fear drugged or contaminated blood, the wrath of God, or the presence of a blood-borne Antediluvian lurking within every drop. Regardless of the reason, unless the vampire is frenzied, the player must succeed on a Willpower roll (difficulty 8) each time the character feeds; Willpower cannot be spent on this roll, and a botch means the character is so revolted by the prospect that she vomits up half her blood pool.

Acute sanguinary aversion usually produces a starve-and-frenzy pattern, as the vampire avoids feeding until she loses control. Alternatively, the character might develop highly ritualized feeding methods — reciting a passage from the Book of Nod, or drinking only from one particular individual — that must be observed before the Kiss can be performed. If the feeding also calls for a Conscience or Conviction roll, increase that roll's difficulty by one.

vtmlarp.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
